name: com.invelon.unity-utilities
description: A collection of standalone Unity Editor tools and utilities: MissingScriptsFinder (find/delete missing scripts in scenes and prefabs), SceneSwitcher (quick-switch scenes from an Editor window), BuildTools/VRGameBuilder (META Quest / PICO Android build pipeline with OpenXR profile switching), and PackageManifestInstaller (one-click UPM dependency installer, also available as its own UPM package under PackageManifestInstaller/).
